items.title: Bob Wilber Interview, 1961-05-01
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] I remember, I think, Albert Nicholas and Zutti and others were there. ... [INTERVIEWEE] Yeah. Yeah.

ctx.x: Well, there was George's Tavern in the village where Frankie Newton used to play and Al Casey, guitar player, played there. The village vanguard used to have nice groups like Art Hodes had a trio there with Max Kaminsky and Freddie Moore.
I remember, I think, Albert Nicholas and Zutti and others were there. Yeah. Lead Belly quite a while.

Yeah. Yeah. Well, I remember, I guess this was 1940 or 41, hearing the wonderful group that Teddy Wilson had at Cafe Society with Edmund Hall and Sid Catlett and Emmett Berry and Benny Morton, who I've been working with recently. Yeah, I remember that group too. Yeah.
